newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares riding new highs led by Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares riding new highs led by Ericsson.

text.p: Swedish share prices held onto early gains at midday Wednesday, bolstered by rises on Wall Street and strength in engineering and technology stocks.
At 1140 GMT the general index had risen 0.91 percent to a new high of 3,173.16. Turnover was a thin 1.8 billion crowns.
Telecoms group Ericsson traded at 335 crowns, up 6.5 because of gains in U.S. high-tech stocks.
Salomon Brothers said it had started coverage of Ericsson with a buy recommendation but said it preferred Nokia Oy for a one-year investment.
Retailer Hennes & Mauritz rose 14 crowns to 345.
Positive industry sales figures pushed the price higher.
"People have been fascinated by the share for a while now and I believe it can continue to climb," one broker said.
Vehicle maker Volvo rose six crowns to 212 and industrial engineering company Atlas Copco rose seven to 235.
"These shares are probably recovering from last week's downturns," one broker said.
Office supplier Esselte slipped two to 192 crowns. It posted a four percent rise in pre-tax profits for the first half of 1997.-- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1005
